name: issue-board
description: The repository's open GitHub issues and pull requests in a pane and under the prompt, with acceptance progress and CI, and a button that hands an issue to Claude.

moveToDone.title: Move closed issues to Done
moveToDone.description: When an issue closes as completed, move it to Done in the project. It changes the shared project from your session.

moveToVerification.title: Move to Verification on a Refs merge
moveToVerification.description: When a pull request that refers to an issue with Refs merges, move the issue to Verification in the project. It changes the shared project from your session.

claimOnStart.title: Start assigns and moves the issue
claimOnStart.description: Start, and Claude starting on an issue, assign it to you and move it to In progress.

workingNote.title: Working note in the system prompt
workingNote.description: While Claude works on an issue you started, the system prompt names it and says how to tick its boxes and change it.

prRule.title: Working note's pull request rule
prRule.description: How the working note tells Claude to name the issue in a pull request: closes-when-ticked writes Closes only when every box is ticked and Refs otherwise, always-closes always writes Closes, none says nothing. The background agent follows it too.

issueCopies.title: Copies of issues a prompt names
issueCopies.description: A prompt that names #123 carries the board's copy of that issue or pull request, unseen.

suggestNextStep.title: Suggest the next step
suggestNextStep.description: After Claude's turn, the prompt box suggests the next step for the issue Claude is on, in place of Claude Code's own suggestion.

followBranch.title: Follow the branch
followBranch.description: Checking out a branch named for an issue, such as fix/315-glide, makes it the issue Claude is on.

nowCount.title: Priorities that count as Now
nowCount.description: How many of the project's first Priority options the Now filter shows, and triage sends to Ready. The rest are Later.
